input.quote: (iv) Transition. Each Party shall use Diligent Efforts to cooperate with the other and/or its designee to effect a smooth and orderly transition in the Development, sale and ongoing marketing, promotion and commercialization of the Product in the Ono Territory during the Wind-down Period and to conduct in an expeditious manner any activities to be conducted under this Section 14.2.
input.rationale: Article XIV's wind-down regime runs entirely in Array's favour: Ono must transition Clinical Studies (14.2(a)(i)), assign Regulatory Filings and hand over all Data and Ono Know-How (14.2(a)(iii)), provide customer lists and data (14.2(a)(iv)), and deliver or destroy Array materials (14.2(a)(vi)). The only mutual language, Section 14.2(a)(iv), is a Diligent Efforts cooperation covenant limited to transitioning the Product back to Array during the Wind-down Period; it imposes no fixed assistance period running from expiry or termination and no obligation on Array to return or export Ono's data at all. Article X contains no return-of-Confidential-Information mechanic either. No usable clause therefore exists, so we insert the shortest fallback provision: at least 90 days of transition assistance from Array on any expiry or termination and export of Ono's Data within 30 days. We have not added the preferred six-month/machine-readable/certified-deletion terms.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

proposal.summary: Insert reciprocal Array transition-assistance and Ono data-return obligation in Section 14.2(a)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XIV requires Ono to transition everything back to Array but gives us nothing on exit. We have added a short reciprocal provision: on expiry or termination Array provides at least 90 days of transition assistance and exports our Data within 30 days, which is our fallback position.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Return of Ono Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Array shall (A) at Ono's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Ono for a period of at least ninety (90) days, and (B) within thirty (30) days, export and deliver to Ono all Data and other information belonging to, supplied by or generated for Ono that is in Array's possession or control.
